prompt: Assess the most recent quarter’s sales patterns to identify products with low stock (<100), check if based on last 6 month sales performance any of them might run out of stock in next 14 days
title: Quarterly Sales and Stock Risk
summary: Assess the most recent quarter’s sales patterns to identify products with stock below 100 units. Use the last 6 months of sales performance to estimate whether any of these products may run out of stock within the next 14 days.
executed_sql_queries:
SELECT p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, s.store_name, i.stock_level AS current_stock_level
FROM retail.inventory i
JOIN retail.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE i.stock_level < 100
ORDER BY s.store_name, p.product_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS inventory_rows, MIN(stock_level) AS min_stock_level, MAX(stock_level) AS max_stock_level
FROM retail.inventory;

WITH low_stock AS (
    SELECT i.store_id, i.product_id, i.stock_level
    FROM retail.inventory i
    WHERE i.stock_level < 100
),
recent_sales AS (
    SELECT
        o.store_id,
        oi.product_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS sales_month,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS monthly_units,
        SUM(oi.total_amount) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN retail.order_items oi
      ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
     AND o.store_id = oi.store_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= (SELECT MAX(order_date) - INTERVAL '6 months' FROM retail.orders)
    GROUP BY o.store_id, oi.product_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        ls.store_id,
        ls.product_id,
        ls.stock_level,
        SUM(rs.monthly_units) AS six_month_units_sold,
        SUM(rs.monthly_revenue) AS six_month_revenue,
        SUM(rs.monthly_units) / 6.0 AS average_monthly_sales_units,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) < 2 THEN 'flat'
            WHEN MAX(rs.monthly_units) > MIN(rs.monthly_units) * 1.2 THEN 'increasing'
            WHEN MIN(rs.monthly_units) > MAX(rs.monthly_units) * 1.2 THEN 'decreasing'
            ELSE 'flat'
        END AS sales_trend_indicator
    FROM low_stock ls
    LEFT JOIN recent_sales rs
      ON ls.store_id = rs.store_id
     AND ls.product_id = rs.product_id
    GROUP BY ls.store_id, ls.product_id, ls.stock_level
)
SELECT
    s.store_name,
    p.product_name,
    p.sku,
    p.category_id,
    p.type_id,
    a.stock_level,
    a.six_month_units_sold,
    a.six_month_revenue,
    a.average_monthly_sales_units,
    a.sales_trend_indicator
FROM agg a
JOIN retail.products p
  ON a.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s
  ON a.store_id = s.store_id
ORDER BY s.store_name, p.product_name;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS low_stock_rows,
  MIN(stock_level) AS min_stock,
  MAX(stock_level) AS max_stock
FROM retail.inventory
WHERE stock_level < 100;

WITH latest_order_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date
  FROM retail.orders
), period_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('quarter', max_order_date)::date AS latest_completed_quarter_start,
    (date_trunc('quarter', max_order_date) - INTERVAL '6 months')::date AS six_month_start,
    max_order_date::date AS report_date
  FROM latest_order_date
), low_stock AS (
  SELECT i.store_id, i.product_id, i.stock_level
  FROM retail.inventory i
  WHERE i.stock_level < 100
), sales_6m AS (
  SELECT
    oi.store_id,
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold_6m,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS revenue_6m,
    COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)) AS active_months_6m
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
   AND o.store_id = oi.store_id
  CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
  WHERE o.order_date >= pb.six_month_start
    AND o.order_date <= pb.report_date
  GROUP BY oi.store_id, oi.product_id
)
SELECT
  s.store_name,
  p.product_name,
  p.sku,
  ls.stock_level,
  COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0) AS units_sold_6m,
  COALESCE(s6.revenue_6m, 0) AS revenue_6m,
  ROUND(COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0)::numeric / 6.0, 2) AS avg_monthly_sales_units,
  ROUND(COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0)::numeric / 180.0, 4) AS est_daily_sales_velocity,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(ls.stock_level::numeric / (COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0)::numeric / 180.0), 2)
  END AS days_of_stock_remaining,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0) = 0 THEN FALSE
    WHEN ls.stock_level::numeric / (COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0)::numeric / 180.0) <= 14 THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS stockout_risk_flag,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0) = 0 THEN 3
    WHEN ls.stock_level::numeric / (COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0)::numeric / 180.0) <= 7 THEN 1
    WHEN ls.stock_level::numeric / (COALESCE(s6.units_sold_6m, 0)::numeric / 180.0) <= 14 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END AS replenishment_priority
FROM low_stock ls
JOIN retail.products p
  ON p.product_id = ls.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s
  ON s.store_id = ls.store_id
LEFT JOIN sales_6m s6
  ON s6.store_id = ls.store_id
 AND s6.product_id = ls.product_id
ORDER BY replenishment_priority ASC, days_of_stock_remaining ASC NULLS LAST, units_sold_6m DESC, s.store_name, p.product_name
LIMIT 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS inventory_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN stock_level < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_stock_rows, MIN(stock_level) AS min_stock, MAX(stock_level) AS max_stock FROM retail.inventory;
